Primary (1 month): 1d6 Humanity Loss on the dose. Takes 24 hours of doing nothing else to administer, never in a fight; a second dose in the month is an overdose (hospital and Addiction Therapy). BODY +3, HP and Death Save included, stacking with chrome. Fits of rage. No effect on FBCs or anyone with an internal Linear Frame. Secondary (DV29): addicted; COOL −2 and REF −1 for good (min 1); without Juice running, BODY and MOVE −2 and you crave it. Rapidetox ends the high, not the habit: only Addiction Therapy does.

Cost: 1,000eb
